If you might act on these thoughts, call your local emergency number now or go to the nearest emergency department. If you’re in Canada or the U.S., call or text **988**. Please also tell someone you trust and avoid being alone.

I’m here with you. Before we start, please answer one thing plainly: **are you safe right now, with no immediate plan or intention to harm yourself?**
